Liverpool Draws with Nottingham Forest After Comeback

Liverpool twice came from behind to secure a 2-2 draw against Nottingham Forest in a Premier League match. Nottingham Forest took the lead, but Liverpool equalized. Forest regained the lead in the second half, only for Liverpool to score again to level the match. The game saw a substitution delay that frustrated Nottingham Forest manager Andoni Iraola.
